title: Google rankings and AI recommendations only overlap 17% of the time. Fresh FAQ pages are key.
description:
Google rankings and AI recommendations only overlap 17% of the time. That means the game changed and most businesses haven’t noticed. Princeton tested 10,000 searches: pages with citations from trusted sources showed up in AI answers 115% more often, and AI referral traffic converts at 14%, versus under 2% from regular search. The fastest move this week: publish an FAQ page loaded with stats and trusted source links. Fresh FAQ pages get picked up 4x more often.

Comment “GEO” and I’ll send you my FAQ template.
